title: shop: product usage
description: Who uses the product and what they do, from product events: active users, new against returning, weekly retention, the pages people view and the records they create, update and delete. CRUD events are emitted automatically by the generated handlers (signals.product_events = False turns them off); page_viewed comes from the browser runtime. Hosted environments only: a local forge env up has no product_events table.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users with any product event in the day, 7 days and 30 days before the end of the range (DAU, WAU, MAU), and stickiness: DAU over MAU.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExactIf(UserId, Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS dau,
       uniqExactIf(UserId, Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS wau,
       uniqExact(UserId) AS mau,
       round(dau / nullIf(mau, 0), 2) AS stickiness
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))

panels.title: Daily active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users with any product event, per UTC day.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS day, uniqExact(UserId) AS users
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: New vs returning users per day
panels.description: Each day's active users in exactly one class: new on the day of their first event, returning after it. First-seen is the first event in the 90 days before the end of the range (or since the start of a longer range), so a user idle for longer than that counts as new again on their return.
panels.sql:
SELECT a.day AS day,
       countIf(a.day = f.first_day) AS new_users,
       countIf(a.day > f.first_day) AS returning_users
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS day, UserId
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY day, UserId
) AS a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, toStartOfDay(min(Timestamp)) AS first_day
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= least({from:DateTime64(9)}, {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY UserId
) AS f ON a.UserId = f.UserId
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Weekly retention by cohort
panels.description: Users grouped by the week (Monday, UTC) of their first event, over the 12 weeks before the end of the range (whatever range is selected), and the percentage active again N weeks later. A week that has not happened yet is empty. A user's first event is their first in the 90 days before the end of the range, so one idle for longer joins the cohort of their return.

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: page_viewed events by route: views, distinct signed-in users and sessions.
panels.sql:
SELECT Props['route'] AS route, count() AS views,
       uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '') AS users,
       uniqExactIf(SessionId, SessionId != '') AS sessions
FROM product_events
WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY route ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Records created, updated and deleted
panels.description: The automatic CRUD product events, per entity and action, over time.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t,
       concat(replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', ''), ' ', extract(EventName, '(created|updated|deleted)$')) AS action,
       count() AS events
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY t, action ORDER BY t

panels.title: Actions per entity
panels.description: Creates, updates and deletes per entity in the range, and the distinct users who made them.
panels.sql:
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', '') AS entity,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_created')) AS created,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_updated')) AS updated,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_deleted')) AS deleted,
       uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '') AS users
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY entity ORDER BY created + updated + deleted DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Most active users
panels.description: Signed-in users by product events in the range, with the days they were active and when they were last seen.
panels.sql:
SELECT UserId AS user_id, count() AS events,
       uniqExact(toDate(Timestamp)) AS active_days,
       uniqExact(EventName) AS distinct_events,
       formatDateTime(max(Timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS last_seen_utc
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY UserId ORDER BY events DESC, user_id LIMIT 25

panels.title: Events by name
panels.description: Every product event in the range, automatic or tracked by the app, with the distinct users who did it.
panels.sql:
SELECT EventName AS event, count() AS events, uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '') AS users
FROM product_events
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY EventName ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100
